definition: a value I hold adding to attraction on top of the visual channels

settled:
An image embodying freedom lifted an already-peak image past its ceiling, with no visual change at all.

Freedom is a value I already knew was load-bearing for me, and it had never been tied to my aesthetic response before.

So the resonance of a value I hold can add to attraction on top of the visual channels, and it can move a response I do not choose.

title: When A Value Lifts A Face
